abstract: OBJECTIVE: Oncofetal protein insulin-like growth factor II mRNA-binding protein 1 (IMP1) regulates cellular proliferation and migration. Expression of IMP1 is limited to a few adult human tissues. However, it commonly expresses in a variety of cancers. Our objective was to study the regulatory mechanism of IMP1 on the cellular functions of choriocarcinoma (CC) JAR cells. METHODS: IMP1 protein levels were measured in CC tissues via immunohistochemistry. Specific siRNAs were used to down-regulate gene expressions. The abilities of migration and invasion were estimated by wound-healing and Matrigel chamber assays. The profile of IMP1-binding genes was investigated with an Agilent microarray. RT-qPCR, RNA immunoprecipitation, and IMP1 rescue experiments were performed to confirm the association between IMP1 and its binding genes. Gene expression was further analyzed by using RT-PCR and Western blotting. RESULTS: Strong IMP1 expressions were frequently detected in CC tissues. Knockdown of IMP1 expression in JAR cells inhibited cell migration and invasion, but did not affect cellular proliferation and morphology. Microarray and RNA-immunoprecipitation results revealed several candidate genes regulated by IMP1. Among them, ribosomal protein S6 kinase (RSK2) and protein phosphatase methylesterase 1 (PPME1) were confirmed to be down-regulated in IMP1-depleted JAR cells. Re-expression of IMP1 into the cells restored the expressions of RSK2 and PPME1. Furthermore, the depletion of RSK2 or PPME1 decreased the migration and invasion of JAR cells. CONCLUSION: Our results suggest that IMP1 plays an essential role in the regulation of migration and invasion of human CC cells, possibly through the novel effectors RSK2 and PPME1.
abstract_ja: 目的：オンコフェタル蛋白であるインスリン様成長因子IIのmRNA結合蛋白1（IMP1）が、絨毛癌（CC）JAR細胞の細胞機能に及ぼす制御機構を検討すること。方法：絨毛癌組織におけるIMP1蛋白レベルを免疫組織化学で測定した。遺伝子発現の抑制にはsiRNAを用いた。遊走と浸潤の能力は創傷治癒アッセイとマトリゲルチャンバーアッセイで評価した。IMP1結合遺伝子のプロファイルはアジレント・マイクロアレイで調べた。候補遺伝子とIMP1の関連を確認するため、RT-qPCR、RNA免疫沈降、IMP1の再導入実験を行った。遺伝子発現はRT-PCRとウエスタンブロッティングでさらに解析した。結果：絨毛癌組織では強いIMP1発現がしばしば認められた。JAR細胞でIMP1の発現をノックダウンすると遊走と浸潤が抑制されたが、増殖と形態には影響がなかった。マイクロアレイとRNA免疫沈降の結果、IMP1が制御する候補遺伝子がいくつか明らかになった。その中で、リボソームタンパク質S6キナーゼ（RSK2）とタンパク質ホスファターゼメチルエステラーゼ1（PPME1）がIMP1除去JAR細胞で発現低下することが確認された。IMP1の再発現によりRSK2とPPME1の発現は回復した。さらに、RSK2またはPPME1の除去はJAR細胞の遊走と浸潤を低下させた。結論：IMP1は、ヒト絨毛癌細胞の遊走と浸潤に重要な役割を果たしており、RSK2とPPME1という新規エフェクターを介している可能性が示唆された。
